corrections.trigger: A managed target was absent at the initial snapshot, or an owned atomic write replaced a symlink target inode before compensation.
corrections.change: Managed writes now compare the full initial snapshot, compensation records the exact post-write snapshot, and rollback accepts only that owned post-write state before restoring the original file or symlink target.

corrections.trigger: A managed removal or rollback could act on a path whose state changed after the snapshot, including a path created after an absent snapshot.
corrections.change: Removals now assert snapshot ownership immediately before deletion, track successful removals, and require the owned post-removal state before rollback removal or restoration.

notes: No new root is counted in fixedRoots because both accepted roots were already fixed by fix1; this wave corrected residual integration behavior within those roots.
